meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档变成 kawaii 风格的 NotebookLM 幻灯片 PDF；若配置了 WOWerpoint 服务器，还会生成手机竖版分享链接。
howto.when: 当你提到「wowerpoint 这个」「把这份报告做成幻灯片」等说法，或要求把某份文件渲染成幻灯片时触发；只处理单份文档。

say.text: 把这份报告做成幻灯片
say.note: 默认用文档标题当故事主题

say.text: 把这个文件做成幻灯片，用猫娘角色讲
say.note: 你的提示词会原样传给生成引擎

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF; if the WOWerpoint server is configured, it also returns a 9:16 mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "wowerpoint this", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as slides. One source doc only.

say_en.note: Default prompt uses the doc's H1 as subject

say_en.text: Make slides from this file, cat-girl narrator
say_en.note: Your prompt is passed through verbatim
